task: P2-T12 — make secrets.bin write atomic and fail-closed on empty existing file

implementation.approach: manual temp file + fs::rename (tempfile NOT used — it is only a transitive dep in Cargo.lock, not a direct dep of Cargo.toml; avoided per no-new-deps guidance)
implementation.save: write to `{FILE_NAME}.tmp-{pid}-{rand}` in the same dir (same filesystem → atomic POSIX rename), create with 0600 mode at open time on POSIX (no permission window), then write MAGIC+payload, flush, sync_all on the temp, fs::rename over the destination, best-effort directory fsync on POSIX
implementation.windows: std::fs::rename uses MoveFileEx MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING, so it replaces an existing destination; documented in the save() doc comment, no staged backup dance kept (minimal)
implementation.load: existing-but-empty (zero-byte) file now returns Err '... is empty (truncated write?); refusing to treat it as a fresh store'; missing file still returns fresh empty map; all other corrupt-file paths unchanged

tests_added: an_empty_existing_store_fails_closed (fail-first: old code returned Ok(Secrets::new()) for zero-byte file — assert message documents the silent-wipe defect)

verification.git_diff: src-tauri scoped diff contains ONLY src-tauri/src/secrets.rs; no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changes
